items.explanation_ko: 분석가는 여성 운용 펀드의 1.2%p 초과 수익을 여성의 판단력 덕분으로 본다. A에 따르면 여성 운용 펀드는 시장을 이긴 섹터에 몰려 있었고 같은 섹터 안에서 비교하면 차이가 없었으므로, 차이는 성별이 아닌 섹터 구성에서 나온다. 오답: B는 일부 펀드의 부진으로 평균 차이를 부정하지 않는다. C는 자금 유입에 관한 것으로 수익률 비교와 무관하다. D는 연도별 변동이라는 일반론으로 5년 평균 차이를 설명하지 못한다.

items.stimulus: Behavioural economists have documented that the way choices are presented—the 'choice architecture'—substantially affects the decisions people make, even when the underlying options remain identical. Default options are accepted at far higher rates than the same options would be if they had to be actively chosen. The order in which options appear influences which gets selected. The number of options available affects whether people decide at all (paradoxically, too many options can cause people to defer the decision entirely). These effects persist even when participants are aware of them and attempt to compensate. The implications cut in multiple directions: choice architecture can be deliberately designed to nudge people toward beneficial choices (organ donation enrollment, retirement savings), but the same mechanisms can be exploited to manipulate consumers, voters, or vulnerable individuals into choices that serve someone else's interests rather than their own.
items.question: Which of the following can be most reasonably inferred from the passage?

options.text: Training people to recognise choice-architecture effects is enough to neutralise their influence on decisions.
Default options generally steer people toward choices that serve their own long-term interests.
Removing default options altogether would be the most reliable way to protect consumers and voters from manipulation.
The same design techniques can serve people's interests or exploit them, raising ethical questions about who designs choices.

items.explanation_ko: 지문은 기본값, 순서, 선택지 수가 결정에 영향을 주고 이를 알아도 효과가 지속되며, 같은 기법이 장기기증·은퇴저축처럼 유익하게도, 소비자·유권자 조작처럼 착취적으로도 쓰일 수 있다고 한다. 따라서 D가 정답이다. 오답: A는 인식하고 보정하려 해도 효과가 지속된다는 지문과 모순된다. B는 기본값이 대체로 본인 이익에 맞는다고 단정하는데 지문은 양면을 말한다. C는 기본값 제거를 최선책으로 단정하는데, 지문에 따르면 기본값은 유익하게도 쓰이며 순서나 선택지 수 같은 다른 효과도 남는다.

items.stimulus: A nutritionist argues: 'Studies consistently show that countries with higher per capita fish consumption have lower rates of cardiovascular disease. Mediterranean and Scandinavian populations, both of which consume substantially more fish than typical Western populations, show heart disease rates 30-40% below the global average. The Australian government should therefore launch a public campaign encouraging citizens to eat more fish to reduce heart disease deaths nationwide.'
items.question: The nutritionist's argument depends on which of the following assumptions?

options.text: Fish consumption in Australia has declined steadily over the past decade as retail fish prices have risen faster than other foods.
Fish is the main dietary factor that determines a population's rate of cardiovascular disease.
Australia's rate of cardiovascular disease is currently above the global average for developed nations.
Those populations' lower heart disease rates stem from eating fish, not from other features of their diets or lifestyles.

items.explanation_ko: 영양학자는 생선을 많이 먹는 나라의 심장병이 적다는 상관에서 생선 섭취 권장 캠페인을 이끌어낸다. 이 결론은 낮은 심장병률이 전반적 식단이나 생활습관 같은 다른 특성이 아니라 생선 섭취 때문이라는 가정에 의존하므로 D가 정답이다. 오답: A는 호주의 최근 소비 추세와 가격으로 결론에 필요하지 않다. B는 생선이 '주된' 요인이어야 할 필요가 없어 필요 이상으로 강하다. C는 호주의 순위가 어떻든 권고는 성립한다.

items.stimulus: Public discussions of environmental challenges often present individual consumer choices—using reusable bags, reducing meat consumption, choosing efficient appliances—as the primary path to sustainability. While individual actions matter, framing the problem this way can obscure the much larger contribution of systemic factors. Industrial agriculture, electricity generation, transportation infrastructure, building codes, and supply chain logistics produce environmental impacts that dwarf those of individual consumer choices. A household that aggressively reduces its energy use achieves perhaps 5-10% emissions reduction; a power grid that shifts from coal to renewable generation can reduce that household's emissions by 50% or more without any change in consumer behaviour. This does not mean individual actions are worthless—they shape culture, signal preferences, and contribute marginal reductions—but treating them as the primary lever conceals the policy interventions where dramatic progress would actually occur.
items.question: What is the author's central argument?

options.text: Individual consumer choices make too small a difference to environmental outcomes to be worth encouraging.
Individual actions matter but are dwarfed by systemic factors, so framing sustainability around them hides the main levers.
Because systemic factors dominate, government regulation alone can achieve sustainability without any change in consumer behaviour.
Shifting electricity grids to renewable sources is the single most effective environmental policy currently available.

items.explanation_ko: 저자는 개인의 소비 선택이 가치가 없지는 않지만 산업, 전력, 교통 같은 시스템 요인에 비해 영향이 훨씬 작고, 개인 행동을 주된 해법으로 내세우면 큰 진전이 가능한 정책 지점이 가려진다고 주장한다. 이것이 B다. 오답: A는 개인 행동을 권장할 가치조차 없다고 하지만 저자는 그 가치를 인정한다. C는 정부 규제만으로 충분하다고 단정하는데 저자는 그렇게까지 말하지 않는다. D는 전력망 전환을 단일 최선 정책으로 순위 매기는데, 지문에서는 예시일 뿐이다.

items.stimulus: Researcher Dr. Park argues that limiting teenagers' social media use to under 1 hour per day reduces depression rates. Critics suggest the relationship is the reverse—depressed teenagers spend more time on social media—or that some third factor (family stress, sleep problems) causes both heavy social media use and depression.
items.question: Which of the following, if true, would most strongly support Dr. Park's argument?

options.text: Teenagers who use social media for less than 1 hour a day report higher life satisfaction than heavy users.
Teenage depression rates rose during the same decade in which social media use became widespread.
In a randomised trial of matched adolescents, those assigned a 1-hour daily limit later had 35% fewer new depression diagnoses.
Teenagers who chose on their own to cut back their social media use reported fewer depressive symptoms six months later than those who did not.

items.explanation_ko: 비판자들은 역인과(우울한 청소년이 더 많이 사용)와 제3 요인(가족 스트레스, 수면)을 제기한다. C는 조건을 맞춘 청소년을 무작위로 사용 제한군에 배정한 뒤 새 우울증 진단이 35% 적었음을 보여, 두 반론을 모두 배제하고 제한이 원인임을 지지한다. 오답: A와 B는 관찰된 상관으로 역인과와 교란 요인을 배제하지 못한다. D는 스스로 사용을 줄이기로 선택한 사람들이라 자기선택 문제가 남아 C보다 약하다.

items.stimulus: A psychology researcher reports: 'Students who studied with classical music in the background scored 15% higher on memory tests than students who studied in silence. The effect was statistically significant. Classical music therefore enhances memory formation and should be incorporated into educational settings.'
items.question: Which of the following, if true, would most seriously weaken the researcher's conclusion?

options.text: Students chose their own condition, and those who chose music were more motivated and higher-achieving to begin with.
Some students said they preferred studying in silence even after hearing about the music group's results.
The memory tests used multiple-choice questions rather than free recall of the material students had studied.
Earlier studies of background music and memory in other countries have reported mixed results.

items.explanation_ko: 연구자는 음악 조건의 15% 높은 점수를 음악의 효과로 결론짓는다. A처럼 학생들이 조건을 스스로 골랐고 음악을 고른 학생이 원래 더 동기가 높고 성취 수준이 높았다면, 점수 차이는 음악이 아니라 학생 차이로 설명될 수 있다. 오답: B는 선호에 관한 것으로 효과와 무관하다. C는 두 조건에 같은 시험이 쓰였으므로 비교 자체를 무너뜨리지 않는다. D는 다른 연구의 엇갈린 결과라는 일반론으로 이 연구의 결함을 짚지 못한다.

items.stimulus: The history of major scientific discoveries reveals a recurring pattern. When Alexander Fleming noticed that mould in a contaminated petri dish had killed surrounding bacteria, he recognised an opportunity that countless previous scientists with similar dishes had overlooked. When Crick and Watson assembled the structure of DNA, they synthesised data that other researchers had collected but failed to interpret correctly. The pattern suggests that scientific breakthroughs depend not only on the available data but on the prepared mind capable of recognising significance—a perspective shaped by years of background knowledge, exposure to relevant problems, and intellectual freedom to pursue unexpected findings. Without such preparation, the same data passes by unnoticed; with it, what previously appeared as ordinary becomes a recognisable signal of something profound.
items.question: Which of the following can be most reasonably inferred from the passage?

options.text: Major discoveries depend mostly on chance encounters with unexpected data, such as a contaminated petri dish.
Advanced data-processing tools now make the prepared mind less necessary for modern scientific discoveries.
Breakthroughs require both available data and a mind prepared by background knowledge to recognise its significance.
Fleming, Crick and Watson succeeded mainly because they had access to data unavailable to other scientists.

items.explanation_ko: 지문은 플레밍과 크릭·왓슨의 예를 들어, 같은 데이터라도 배경 지식으로 준비된 사람만 그 의미를 알아본다고 설명한다. 따라서 돌파구에는 데이터와 그것을 알아볼 준비된 관점이 모두 필요하다는 C가 정답이다. 오답: A는 우연을 주된 요인으로 보지만 지문은 준비를 강조한다. B는 현대에는 준비된 마음이 덜 필요하다고 하는데 근거가 없다. D는 다른 과학자들도 비슷한 접시와 데이터를 가졌다는 지문과 모순된다.

items.stimulus: A police chief argues: 'Cities that increased their police force size by 10% or more in the past five years have seen violent crime drop by an average of 15%. Cities that maintained or reduced police staffing have seen violent crime stay flat or rise. Therefore, our city should immediately expand the police force by 15% to reduce crime.'
items.question: The chief's argument depends on which of the following assumptions?

options.text: Expanding the police force is the most effective crime-prevention strategy available to the city.
A 15% expansion can be funded within the city's current budget without cutting other services.
The city's violent crime rate is currently higher than that of the cities that expanded their police forces over the period.
The crime drop in expanding cities was caused by the extra police, not by other changes in those cities.

items.explanation_ko: 서장은 경찰을 늘린 도시에서 폭력 범죄가 15% 줄었다는 비교에서 우리 도시도 경찰을 늘리면 범죄가 줄 것이라고 결론짓는다. 이는 범죄 감소가 그 도시들의 다른 변화가 아니라 경찰 증원 때문이라는 가정에 의존하므로 D가 정답이다. 오답: A는 가장 효과적인 전략일 필요가 없다. B는 예산 문제로 범죄 감소 결론과 무관하다. C는 우리 도시의 범죄율이 그 도시들보다 높을 필요가 없다.

items.stimulus: Discussions of unemployment often present individual unemployment as primarily a matter of individual responsibility—skills, motivation, willingness to relocate or accept lower wages. While individual factors clearly matter, focusing exclusively on them can obscure structural realities that shape what individuals can actually achieve. When manufacturing automation eliminates 100,000 factory positions in a region, those workers cannot simply 'find other work' through individual effort if no comparable jobs exist nearby. Their education was appropriate for the work that existed when they trained; their relocation depends on housing markets, family ties, and savings they may not have. Their reskilling depends on access to training programs, available time outside survival activities, and the existence of local jobs to apply learned skills to. The individual-responsibility frame remains true at the level of comparing two unemployed people in the same context, but it becomes misleading when used to explain why entire regions or industries face employment crises.
items.question: What is the author's central argument?

options.text: Individual factors explain differences between people in the same context, but not region- or industry-wide unemployment.
Unemployed people bear little responsibility for their situation, since structural forces largely determine their job prospects.
Governments should slow manufacturing automation to protect regions that depend heavily on factory employment.
Better access to retraining programs would allow displaced workers to overcome structural unemployment on their own.

items.explanation_ko: 저자는 개인 요인이 분명히 중요하고 같은 맥락의 두 사람을 비교할 때는 개인 책임 관점이 유효하지만, 지역이나 산업 전체의 고용 위기를 설명할 때는 구조적 현실을 가려 오해를 낳는다고 주장한다. 이것이 A다. 오답: B는 개인 책임을 거의 부정하지만 저자는 개인 요인이 중요하다고 인정한다. C는 자동화 속도 조절이라는 처방으로 지문에 없다. D는 재교육만으로 혼자 극복할 수 있다고 하지만, 지문은 재교육도 지역 일자리 존재 등 구조에 달려 있다고 한다.

items.stimulus: Tech consultant Mr. Chen argues that automating routine administrative tasks in hospitals will substantially reduce nurse burnout. He proposes that by removing data entry, scheduling, and documentation tasks from nurses' workflows, hospitals could allow nurses to focus on direct patient care, which surveys consistently show is the most fulfilling part of their work. Critics argue that nurse burnout has multiple causes—chronic understaffing, emotional toll of patient deaths, complex clinical decision-making—and that simply removing administrative tasks may produce minimal benefit if these other factors remain unchanged.
items.question: Which of the following, if true, would most strongly support Mr. Chen's argument?

options.text: Surveys show that most nurses are dissatisfied with the amount of administrative work they currently do.
Hospitals that automated administrative tasks, without changing other conditions, saw burnout fall by 40% over two years.
Nurses who spend more of their shift on direct patient care report higher job satisfaction than nurses who spend less time on it.
Hospitals with more advanced technology systems find it easier to recruit new nursing graduates.

items.explanation_ko: 비판자는 번아웃의 원인이 여럿이어서 행정 업무만 없애서는 효과가 작을 것이라고 반박한다. B는 다른 근무 조건을 바꾸지 않은 병원에서도 자동화 후 번아웃이 40% 줄었음을 보여 이 반론을 직접 막는다. 오답: A는 행정 업무에 불만이 있다는 것일 뿐 자동화가 번아웃을 줄인다는 증거가 아니다. C는 직접 간호와 만족의 연관으로 지문에 이미 전제된 내용이며 번아웃 감소 효과를 보여주지 않는다. D는 채용에 관한 것으로 번아웃과 무관하다.

items.stimulus: An education policy advocate argues: 'Smaller class sizes substantially improve student outcomes. Schools with classes averaging fewer than 20 students show 18% higher test scores than schools with average class sizes of 30 or more. We should mandate maximum class sizes of 20 across all schools to dramatically improve educational outcomes.'
items.question: Which of the following, if true, would most seriously weaken the advocate's conclusion?

options.text: Teachers in schools with small classes report higher job satisfaction than teachers with larger classes.
Small-class schools also have more experienced teachers; with teacher quality held constant, class size barely matters.
The 18% difference in test scores has remained stable over the past decade of national testing.
Larger classes tend to include a more diverse mix of students in terms of background and ability, which some teachers find harder to manage.

items.explanation_ko: 옹호자는 작은 학급 학교의 18% 높은 점수를 학급 규모의 효과로 본다. B에 따르면 작은 학급 학교는 더 경험 많은 교사를 두고 있었고, 교사 수준을 같게 맞추면 학급 규모 효과가 거의 사라지므로 차이의 원인은 학급 규모가 아니다. 오답: A는 교사 만족도로 학생 성과와 무관하다. C는 격차가 안정적이라는 정보로 원인을 바꾸지 못한다. D는 큰 학급의 다양성과 지도의 어려움을 말할 뿐 점수 차이가 학급 규모 때문이 아니라는 점을 보여주지 못한다.

items.stimulus: Conventional wisdom suggests that we know our own minds better than anyone else does—that introspection gives us privileged access to our own beliefs, motivations, and emotions. Psychological research increasingly complicates this picture. Studies show that people frequently confabulate explanations for their choices: when asked why they selected one option over another in subtle behavioural experiments, participants confidently produce elaborate rationales that careful analysis reveals are often constructed after the fact rather than reflecting the actual decision process. We may genuinely believe we acted because of reason X when our behaviour was actually driven by factors we never consciously accessed. This does not mean introspection is worthless; we do have some genuine self-knowledge. But it suggests that confidence in self-understanding can far exceed its actual reliability, and that other people's observations about our patterns may sometimes be more accurate than our own.
items.question: Which of the following can be most reasonably inferred from the passage?

options.text: Because people confabulate reasons, introspection gives no genuine insight into one's own motives.
Confidence in self-understanding can exceed its accuracy, so others' observations can usefully add to it.
Other people generally understand our motives and reasons better than we understand them ourselves.
Confabulation occurs mainly in laboratory experiments and rarely affects everyday decisions.

items.explanation_ko: 지문은 사람들이 선택의 이유를 사후에 지어내는 경우가 많아 자기 이해에 대한 확신이 실제 정확도를 넘을 수 있고, 다만 진짜 자기 지식도 있으며 타인의 관찰이 때로 더 정확할 수 있다고 말한다. 따라서 B가 정답이다. 오답: A는 내성이 아무 통찰도 주지 못한다고 하지만 지문은 진짜 자기 지식을 인정한다. C는 '대체로' 타인이 더 잘 안다고 하지만 지문은 '때로'라고만 한다. D는 일상에서는 드물다고 하는데 근거가 없다.

items.stimulus: A health journalist reports: 'New research provides strong evidence that drinking three to four cups of coffee daily protects against Type 2 diabetes. The study followed 50,000 adults for ten years and found that regular coffee drinkers had a 25% lower incidence of new diabetes diagnoses compared to non-coffee-drinkers, with the relationship holding even when researchers adjusted for age, sex, and BMI. With a sample this large and a follow-up period this long, coffee should now be considered a clinically meaningful protective factor against diabetes.'
items.question: Which of the following, if true, would most seriously weaken the journalist's conclusion?

options.text: Coffee contains caffeine and other bioactive compounds whose effects on glucose metabolism have been studied in animals.
The study was funded by a coffee industry consortium that has supported earlier research reporting health benefits of coffee drinking.
The study did not adjust for diet, exercise or smoking, and the coffee drinkers ate better, exercised more and smoked less.
Some prior studies found smaller effects of coffee on diabetes risk, while others found larger effects.

items.explanation_ko: 기자는 대규모 표본과 긴 추적 기간을 근거로 커피가 당뇨 보호 요인이라고 결론짓는다. C는 식단, 운동, 흡연이 보정되지 않았고 커피 음용자가 실제로 이 면에서 더 건강했음을 보여, 25% 차이가 커피가 아닌 생활습관 때문일 수 있게 만든다. 표본이 커도 체계적 교란은 사라지지 않는다. 오답: A는 동물 연구에 관한 일반적 성분 정보다. B는 연구비 출처에 따른 이해관계 우려일 뿐 결과의 구체적 결함을 보여주지 않는다. D는 다른 연구의 엇갈린 결과로 이 연구를 직접 약화하지 않는다.

items.stimulus: An urban policy analyst argues: 'Several Australian cities that invested in major public park expansion programmes during the 2010s saw significant increases in property values within walking distance of those parks—averaging 8% above comparable city-wide trends. The City of Riverton, currently considering whether to fund a $40 million park expansion, should proceed with the investment. The increase in property values will expand the local tax base, which—when combined with health-related cost savings from increased physical activity and reduced air pollution—will more than offset the project's cost over a twenty-year horizon.'
items.question: The analyst's argument depends on which of the following assumptions?

options.text: Riverton currently has fewer parks per resident than the other Australian cities used as comparison cases.
The property-value rises elsewhere were caused by the parks, not by local factors that may not apply to Riverton.
Most Riverton residents support increased public spending on new parks and open space in their suburbs.
Parks deliver larger health benefits per dollar spent than alternative public investments such as transit or social housing.

items.explanation_ko: 분석가는 다른 호주 도시에서 공원 확장 뒤 주변 부동산 가치가 8% 올랐다는 사례로 Riverton도 투자하면 세수 증가와 건강 비용 절감으로 비용을 회수한다고 결론짓는다. 이는 다른 도시의 상승이 그 지역 고유의 요인이 아니라 공원 때문이었고 Riverton에도 적용된다는 가정에 의존하므로 B가 정답이다. 오답: A는 Riverton의 공원이 더 적을 필요가 없다. C는 주민 지지로 비용 회수 논증과 무관하다. D는 교통이나 주택 같은 다른 투자보다 나을 필요가 없으며, 분석가는 비용 회수만 주장한다.

items.stimulus: Psychology has been undergoing a 'replication crisis' since 2015, when a major collaborative project attempted to reproduce the results of 100 prominent published studies and succeeded in fewer than 40 cases. The causes are multiple: small original sample sizes (which can produce statistically significant results that are nonetheless flukes), selective reporting (where only positive results are published), researcher flexibility in data analysis decisions made after seeing the data, and pressure to publish novel rather than confirmatory findings. Importantly, replication failure does not necessarily indicate that original researchers committed fraud or even errors—genuine statistical fluctuation can produce strong effects in one sample that disappear in another, particularly when sample sizes are modest. Recent reforms—pre-registration of hypotheses, larger sample sizes, sharing of data and analysis code, and incentives for replication studies—have been adopted by some journals and funding agencies but remain inconsistent across the field.
items.question: Which of the following can be most reasonably inferred from the passage?

options.text: Psychology findings, especially from small samples or single studies, warrant caution even without evidence of misconduct.
Most failed replications reflect questionable or fraudulent practices by the original researchers.
Small original sample sizes were the single most important cause of the replication crisis in psychology research.
Pre-registration and data sharing have now largely resolved the replication problem across the field of psychology.

items.explanation_ko: 지문은 100개 연구 중 39개만 재현되었고, 원인으로 작은 표본, 선택적 보고, 분석 유연성, 출판 압력을 들며, 재현 실패가 반드시 부정행위를 뜻하지 않는다고 한다. 따라서 특히 작은 표본이나 단일 연구 결과는 부정행위 증거가 없어도 신중히 봐야 한다는 A가 정답이다. 오답: B는 부정행위가 주원인이라고 하지만 지문은 이를 부정한다. C는 여러 원인 중 하나를 '가장 중요한' 원인으로 단정한다. D는 개혁이 문제를 해결했다고 하지만 지문은 개혁이 분야 전체에 일관되지 않다고 한다.

items.stimulus: Dr. Wong, a bioethicist, argues against 'right to try' laws that allow terminally ill patients to access experimental treatments outside formal clinical trials. While she acknowledges that such laws give dying patients hope, she contends they cause more harm than good: by providing access without controlled trial conditions, they undermine the rigorous research process needed to determine which experimental treatments actually work. Pharmaceutical companies, when they can give the drug to patients outside trials, lose incentive to enrol patients in formal studies—which in turn delays or prevents the generation of evidence about effectiveness. Future patients, who could have benefited from properly evaluated treatments, are thus harmed.
items.question: Which of the following, if true, would most strongly support Dr. Wong's argument?

options.text: Several patients treated under right-to-try laws suffered severe side effects that had not appeared in earlier trial data.
Many patients applying for right-to-try access do not meet the eligibility criteria for ongoing clinical trials.
Most terminally ill patients who use right-to-try access report that it gave them hope and a greater sense of control over their treatment.
For drugs available under right-to-try, trial enrolment fell 40% and definitive efficacy data arrived years later than for matched drugs.

items.explanation_ko: Wong 박사의 논증은 시험 밖 접근 허용이 임상시험 등록을 줄이고, 그로 인해 효과 증거가 늦어져 미래 환자가 피해를 본다는 두 단계 인과다. D는 대조 약물과 비교해 등록이 40% 줄고 확정적 효과 자료가 수년 늦어졌음을 보여 두 단계를 모두 뒷받침한다. 오답: A는 현재 환자의 부작용 문제로 Wong이 제시한 연구 과정 훼손 논리와 다른 주장이다. B는 신청자가 원래 시험 자격이 없다면 시험 등록을 빼앗지 않는다는 뜻이 되어 오히려 약화한다. C는 희망과 통제감이라는 이점으로 Wong도 인정한 부분이다.

items.stimulus: A retired judge writes in support of harsher prison sentences: 'Cross-national data tell a clear story. Countries with longer average prison sentences have substantially lower violent crime rates—the correlation is statistically robust. The mechanism is intuitive: the prospect of severe punishment deters would-be criminals, and incarcerated criminals cannot reoffend. Our nation's recent crime increases stem in part from a misguided turn toward shorter sentences and rehabilitation programmes. We should reverse course and increase sentence lengths to bring crime back under control.'
items.question: Which of the following, if true, would most seriously weaken the judge's argument?

options.text: Some legal scholars argue that long sentences are inhumane, regardless of whether they reduce crime.
Prisoners released after short sentences often reoffend, especially within two years of their release.
Short-sentence countries also have strong social services; controlling for these removes the sentence-crime link.
Countries define 'violent crime' differently, which complicates direct international comparisons of crime.

items.explanation_ko: 판사는 형량이 긴 나라일수록 폭력 범죄가 적다는 상관을 근거로 형량을 늘리자고 한다. C에 따르면 짧은 형량 국가들은 강한 사회 서비스도 갖추고 있고 이를 통제하면 형량과 범죄의 연관이 사라지므로, 상관은 형량의 효과가 아니다. 오답: A는 도덕적 비판으로 효과 주장을 건드리지 않는다. B는 오히려 짧은 형량의 문제를 시사한다. D는 국가 간 비교의 어려움을 지적하지만 상관 자체를 무너뜨리지는 못해 C보다 약하다.

items.stimulus: Science is often portrayed as a neutral pursuit of objective truth, but examining its history reveals a more complicated picture. Scientific theories are influenced by the cultural and economic contexts in which scientists work. Newton's mechanical universe reflected the clockwork metaphors of his era. Early evolutionary theory was shaped by Victorian assumptions about competition and progress. Twentieth-century genetics carried implicit ideas about heredity and human worth that contributed to eugenics movements. None of this means scientific findings are arbitrary or that physics works only because Newton was British—the mathematical predictions of physics remain valid regardless of their cultural origins. But it does mean that the questions scientists choose to investigate, the categories they impose on data, the analogies they reach for, and the social implications they draw from results are not insulated from their cultural moment. Understanding science accurately requires holding both truths simultaneously: that scientific findings can have genuine validity, and that the practice of science is unavoidably shaped by the human context in which it occurs.
items.question: What is the author's central argument?

options.text: Scientific findings are unreliable because the theories behind them are shaped by cultural assumptions.
What counts as scientific truth is ultimately determined by the cultural context in which theories develop.
Scientific findings can be genuinely valid even though scientific practice is shaped by cultural context.
Theories shaped by their era's metaphors, like Newton's clockwork mechanics, are eventually overturned for that very reason.

items.explanation_ko: 저자는 과학 이론이 문화적 맥락의 영향을 받는다는 예를 들면서도, 그렇다고 과학적 발견이 임의적인 것은 아니며 물리학의 예측은 문화적 기원과 무관하게 타당하다고 말한다. 마지막 문장에서 두 진실을 함께 붙들어야 한다고 결론지으므로 C가 정답이다. 오답: A는 문화적 영향 때문에 발견을 믿을 수 없다고 하지만 저자는 타당성을 인정한다. B는 문화가 진리를 결정한다는 상대주의로 저자가 부정한다. D는 시대의 비유에 영향받은 이론이 바로 그 이유로 폐기된다고 하지만 지문에 근거가 없다.

items.stimulus: Cancer screening programmes face a fundamental tension that resists simple resolution. Aggressive screening detects more early-stage cancers, which is generally beneficial: many such cancers are treatable when caught early but lethal when discovered late. However, aggressive screening also detects 'indolent' tumours—lesions that meet pathological criteria for cancer but would never have caused clinical symptoms or harm during the patient's natural lifetime. These overdiagnosed cases lead to surgery, radiation, or chemotherapy that the patient did not need, with their own significant morbidity and rare but real mortality risks. Studies of mammography programmes estimate that roughly 20-30% of detected breast cancers may fall into this category, although distinguishing aggressive from indolent cases at the time of diagnosis remains a major unsolved clinical problem. The tension is genuine: a programme tuned to catch every aggressive cancer will also flag many indolent ones, while a programme set to minimise overdiagnosis will miss some genuinely dangerous cancers.
items.question: Which of the following can be most reliably inferred from the passage?

options.text: Screening policy must weigh overdiagnosis against early detection, a balance not settled by test accuracy alone.
Mammography is more prone to overdiagnosis than other forms of cancer screening currently in use.
Because 20-30% of detected breast cancers may be indolent, mammography screening causes more harm than good.
Current diagnostic methods can already distinguish aggressive from indolent tumours, so overdiagnosis is easily avoided.

items.explanation_ko: 지문은 적극적 검진이 조기 발견의 이익과 함께 평생 해가 없었을 종양까지 찾아내 불필요한 치료를 낳으며, 진단 시점에 둘을 구별하는 것은 아직 풀리지 않은 문제라 긴장이 불가피하다고 한다. 따라서 과잉진단의 해와 조기 발견의 이익을 저울질해야 하고 이는 검사 정확도만으로 정해지지 않는다는 A가 정답이다. 오답: B는 유방촬영이 다른 검진보다 더 문제라고 비교하는데 지문에 근거가 없다. C는 해가 이익보다 크다고 단정한다. D는 구별 문제가 미해결이라는 지문과 정면으로 모순된다.

items.stimulus: An environmental policy analyst argues: 'Carbon taxes are demonstrably more effective than emissions regulations at reducing greenhouse gas emissions. Of twelve countries that have implemented economy-wide carbon taxes, all twelve have seen their emissions decrease by an average of 25% over the past decade, while countries relying primarily on regulations have reduced emissions by only 8% on average. Australia should therefore adopt a carbon tax to maximise its emissions reduction efforts.'
items.question: The analyst's argument depends on which of the following assumptions?

options.text: The larger cut in carbon-tax countries was caused by the tax itself and would also occur in Australia.
Australia currently emits more greenhouse gases per capita than the average carbon-tax country.
A carbon tax would be politically acceptable to a majority of Australian voters and businesses.
Emissions regulations played no part in the reductions achieved by the carbon-tax countries.

items.explanation_ko: 분석가는 탄소세 국가의 25% 감축과 규제 국가의 8% 감축을 비교해 호주도 탄소세를 도입해야 한다고 결론짓는다. 이는 차이가 다른 국가별 요인이 아니라 탄소세 자체 때문이며 호주에서도 같은 효과가 날 것이라는 가정에 의존하므로 A가 정답이다. 오답: B는 호주의 배출량 수준이 어떻든 권고는 성립한다. C는 정치적 수용성으로 효과 논증과 무관하다. D는 규제가 아무 역할도 안 했을 필요가 없으며, 탄소세가 더 효과적이기만 하면 된다.

items.stimulus: Cognitive scientist Dr. Levi argues that bilingualism produces measurable cognitive benefits beyond language ability itself. He claims that managing two languages constantly trains executive function—the brain's capacity to focus, switch tasks, and inhibit competing responses—producing transferable advantages on cognitive tasks unrelated to language. Critics counter that observed differences likely reflect socioeconomic factors: bilingual individuals often come from immigrant families with distinctive educational values, multilingual cultures that emphasise cognitive flexibility, or households that intensively prioritise child cognitive development for non-linguistic reasons.
items.question: Which of the following, if true, would most strongly support Dr. Levi's argument against the critics' objection?

options.text: Many countries now promote bilingual education in primary schools as a way to improve learning outcomes.
Bilingual adults outperform monolingual adults on executive-function tasks in studies conducted across many different countries.
Children randomly assigned to dual-language classes, matched on family background, showed lasting executive-function gains.
Some monolingual children from similar family backgrounds score very highly on standard tests of executive function.

items.explanation_ko: 비판자들은 이중언어 화자의 인지 이점이 가정의 사회경제적·문화적 배경 때문일 수 있다고 본다. C는 가정 배경을 맞춘 아이들을 이중언어 수업에 무작위로 배정해 가족 요인을 배제한 뒤에도 지속적인 실행 기능 향상이 나타났음을 보여 반론을 직접 막는다. 오답: A는 정책 동향일 뿐 효과의 증거가 아니다. B는 여러 나라에서 나온 결과라도 관찰 연구라 배경 차이를 배제하지 못한다. D는 일부 단일언어 아동의 사례로 집단 간 평균 차이와 무관하다.

items.stimulus: A historian argues: 'The Roman Empire fell because its citizens lost their moral discipline. Late imperial sources describe widespread luxury, declining religious commitment, weakened civic virtue, and political corruption. Other ancient empires that experienced similar moral decline—including Babylon and the Persian Empire—also collapsed. The pattern is unmistakable: civilisations cannot survive the erosion of their moral foundations, and modern societies that allow similar decline can expect similar consequences.'
items.question: Which of the following, if true, would most seriously weaken the historian's argument?

options.text: Moral standards differ between cultures and periods, so 'moral decline' is difficult to define consistently.
Military, economic and climate pressures better explain Rome's fall, and 'moral decline' texts also appear in thriving eras.
Most surviving late imperial sources were written by members of the educated urban elite rather than by ordinary Roman citizens.
Some historians emphasise the role of individual emperors and generals rather than broad social trends.

items.explanation_ko: 역사가는 후기 로마 문헌의 도덕적 타락 묘사와 다른 제국의 사례를 근거로 도덕 쇠퇴가 멸망의 원인이라고 주장한다. B는 군사, 경제, 기후 요인이라는 더 나은 설명을 제시하고, 도덕 타락을 한탄하는 문헌이 번영기에도 나타났음을 보여 근거 자체를 무력화한다. 오답: A는 도덕 기준이 다르다는 일반론으로 로마 사례를 직접 반박하지 못한다. C는 사료의 저자층에 관한 정보로 인과 주장을 약화하는 힘이 약하다. D는 다른 접근법이 있다는 것일 뿐 주장을 반박하지 않는다.

items.stimulus: The effects of recommendation algorithms—the systems that suggest content based on user behaviour—on public opinion have generated heated debate. Critics argue that these algorithms create 'filter bubbles', where users are exposed to increasingly narrow content matching their existing views, polarising opinions and reducing exposure to diverse perspectives. Defenders counter that traditional media also limited exposure (newspapers had editorial slants; broadcast television offered limited channels) and that algorithms simply automate user preferences that would have operated through other channels anyway. Recent rigorous research suggests both views are partially right but in unexpected ways: recommendation systems do produce more homogeneous content streams than diverse human curation across multiple users, but the strongest filter-bubble effects occur not because algorithms restrict diversity, but because users actively click on, share, and dwell on content that confirms their existing beliefs—the algorithms then amplify these revealed preferences. Removing the algorithms entirely would not eliminate the bubble effect, though it might reduce its intensity.
items.question: Which of the following can be most reasonably inferred from the passage?

options.text: Recommendation algorithms have little effect on what users see, since users' own choices drive their exposure.
Users bear sole responsibility for polarisation online, because algorithms merely reflect the preferences their clicks reveal.
Traditional media exposed most people to a wider range of views than algorithmic feeds do today.
Filter bubbles arise when algorithms amplify users' own choices, so removing algorithms would reduce but not end them.

items.explanation_ko: 지문은 추천 시스템이 다양한 인간 큐레이션보다 동질적인 흐름을 만들지만, 가장 강한 필터버블 효과는 사용자가 기존 신념을 확인하는 콘텐츠를 스스로 클릭하고 알고리즘이 이를 증폭할 때 생기며, 알고리즘을 없애도 효과는 줄 뿐 사라지지 않는다고 한다. 이를 담은 D가 정답이다. 오답: A는 알고리즘 효과가 작다고 하지만 지문은 증폭을 말한다. B는 사용자에게 '전적' 책임을 지우는데 지문은 알고리즘의 증폭 역할도 인정한다. C는 전통 매체가 대부분의 사람에게 더 다양했다고 단정하는데 지문은 이를 비교하지 않는다.

items.stimulus: Free trade is often defended on the grounds that it produces more efficient outcomes than protectionist policies. According to standard economic theory, allowing each country to specialise in producing what it does best maximises total wealth across all participating countries. The aggregate efficiency gains predicted by this analysis have largely materialised. However, the analysis assumed that those gains would be distributed in ways that compensated workers and communities harmed by trade displacement—an assumption that has often failed in practice. Workers in declining industries face long-term unemployment and reduced lifetime earnings without effective safety nets. Manufacturing communities lose their economic base and accumulate the social costs of disruption. The aggregate efficiency gains exist, but the failure to ensure their fair distribution has produced both genuine human costs and the political backlash now reshaping trade policy in many democracies. Defenders of trade who dismiss these costs as anecdotal misunderstand both the empirical evidence and the original logic of their own theoretical framework.
items.question: What is the author's central argument?

options.text: The human costs of trade displacement are serious enough that democracies should now return to protectionist trade policies.
Standard trade theory was mistaken about the efficiency gains that specialisation between countries would produce.
Free trade delivered its predicted gains, but failing to compensate those harmed has caused real costs that cannot be dismissed.
Displacement costs are an unavoidable price of aggregate prosperity and therefore do not weaken the overall case for free trade at all.

items.explanation_ko: 저자는 자유무역의 총 효율 이익은 이론대로 실현되었지만, 피해 노동자와 지역에 대한 보상이라는 전제가 실패해 실제 인적 비용과 정치적 반발을 낳았고, 이를 일화로 치부하는 옹호자는 틀렸다고 주장한다. 이것이 C다. 오답: A는 보호무역 회귀를 주장하지만 저자는 분배 실패를 지적할 뿐이다. B는 이론의 효율 예측이 틀렸다고 하지만 저자는 실현되었다고 한다. D는 저자가 비판하는 '비용 무시' 입장 그 자체다.

items.stimulus: A pharmaceutical researcher concludes: 'In our randomised controlled trial, patients who received our new anticoagulant had a 30% lower rate of stroke over five years compared to patients on the standard treatment, with a p-value of 0.001. Our trial enrolled 4,200 patients across twelve academic medical centres. Therefore, prescribing this drug to all patients at elevated stroke risk in the general population would prevent thousands of strokes annually compared to current standard treatment.'
items.question: The researcher's argument depends on which of the following assumptions?

options.text: Most strokes in the at-risk population could be prevented with appropriate preventive medication.
The drug will be approved by regulators in multiple countries, including Australia, before wide prescribing begins.
Academic medical centres are where most patients at elevated stroke risk in the general population receive their care.
Trial patients represent the wider at-risk population, and bleeding risks will not outweigh the benefit at scale.

items.explanation_ko: 연구자는 학술 의료센터 시험의 30% 뇌졸중 감소를 일반 인구 전체에 적용해 수천 건을 예방할 것이라고 결론짓는다. 이는 시험 참가자가 더 넓은 위험 인구를 대표하고, 항응고제의 출혈 부작용이 인구 차원에서 이익을 상쇄하지 않는다는 가정에 의존하므로 D가 정답이다. 오답: A는 대부분의 뇌졸중이 예방 가능할 필요가 없다. B는 여러 나라의 승인 여부가 효과 논증에 필요하지 않다. C는 환자가 주로 어디서 치료받는지는 필요 없고, 필요한 것은 시험 참가자의 대표성이다.

items.stimulus: Sociologist Dr. Adams proposes that economic inequality, more than absolute poverty levels, drives social unrest and political instability. She argues that some highly unequal but moderately wealthy societies experience more political turmoil than poorer but more equal ones. Her hypothesis: people's psychological wellbeing depends not on their absolute material conditions but on their position relative to others in their society. Critics counter that the apparent correlation between inequality and unrest may be spurious—both could be driven by underlying institutional weaknesses (corruption, weak rule of law, ethnic divisions) rather than inequality directly causing unrest.
items.question: Which of the following, if true, would most strongly support Dr. Adams's hypothesis against the critics' objection?

options.text: Within countries tracked over decades, rises in inequality preceded rises in unrest even with institutions and income controlled.
Countries with high inequality have experienced more protests over the past decade than countries with low inequality levels.
Some economists dispute the way Dr. Adams measures inequality across different countries.
Survey respondents in unequal societies report more concern about their relative status than those in equal societies.

items.explanation_ko: 비판자들은 불평등과 불안의 상관이 제도적 약점이라는 제3 요인 때문일 수 있다고 본다. A는 같은 나라를 수십 년 추적하며 제도와 소득을 통제해도 불평등 증가가 불안 증가에 앞섰음을 보여, 교란 요인과 인과 방향 문제를 함께 다룬다. 오답: B는 국가 간 단순 비교라 비판자의 제3 요인 반론을 피하지 못한다. C는 측정 방식에 대한 이견으로 오히려 약화 쪽이다. D는 상대적 지위에 대한 관심을 보여주지만 제도 요인을 배제하지 못해 A보다 약하다.

items.stimulus: A legal philosopher argues: 'The moral justification for criminal punishment depends entirely on its capacity to deter future crime. If a punishment does not deter, it cannot be justified, regardless of how proportionate it might seem to the offence committed. Recent empirical studies show that increasing prison sentences from five to ten years for similar offences produces no measurable additional deterrent effect on crime rates. Therefore, sentences exceeding five years for these offences are morally unjustified, and we should reduce them as a matter of basic justice.'
items.question: Which of the following, if true, would most seriously weaken the philosopher's argument?

options.text: Some legal scholars argue that no form of criminal punishment can ever be morally justified at all.
Crime rates vary substantially between regions for reasons that have nothing to do with sentence length.
Longer sentences do produce measurable deterrent effects for some other categories of offence.
Retribution and incapacitation are widely accepted justifications for punishment that do not depend on deterrence.

items.explanation_ko: 철학자의 논증은 처벌의 정당화가 전적으로 억제력에 달려 있다는 전제 위에 서 있다. D처럼 응보나 무력화가 억제와 무관하게 처벌을 정당화하는 널리 인정된 근거라면, 억제 효과가 없어도 긴 형량이 정당할 수 있어 전제가 무너진다. 오답: A는 어떤 처벌도 정당화될 수 없다는 주장으로, 오히려 형량 감축 결론과 같은 방향이다. B는 지역별 범죄율 차이로 도덕적 정당화와 무관하다. C는 다른 범죄 유형에 관한 것이라 해당 범죄에 대한 결론을 건드리지 않는다.

items.stimulus: A meta-analysis of 200 studies on homework and academic achievement found that the relationship varies dramatically by age group. For elementary school students, additional homework time showed virtually no correlation with improved test scores. For middle school students, a moderate positive correlation appeared, but only up to about 90 minutes per night. For high school students, the correlation continued strengthening up to about 2 hours, then leveled off. Beyond these thresholds, additional homework offered no measurable benefit.
items.question: Which of the following can be most reliably inferred from the passage?

options.text: Elementary students who spend more time on homework tend to score lower on tests than those who spend less.
How much extra homework helps depends on age, and past certain amounts it shows no measurable added benefit.
Because the high school correlation is strongest, high school students should be set at least two hours a night.
Up to 90 minutes, middle school students gain more from each extra minute of homework than high school students do.

items.explanation_ko: 지문은 숙제 효과가 연령대별로 다르고(초등은 상관 거의 없음, 중등은 약 90분까지, 고등은 약 2시간까지), 그 기준을 넘으면 추가 효과가 없다고 말한다. B는 이 두 사실을 그대로 요약하므로 가장 확실하게 추론된다. 오답: A는 '상관이 없다'를 '점수가 더 낮다'는 음의 관계로 바꿨고, C는 상관이 가장 강하다는 사실에서 '최소 2시간 부과'라는 지문에 없는 처방을 끌어냈으며, D는 중등과 고등의 분당 효과 크기를 비교한 자료가 지문에 없다.

items.stimulus: Recycling has long been promoted as the cornerstone of household environmental responsibility, but research now suggests this emphasis may be misplaced. Studies of household carbon footprints reveal that recycling decisions account for less than 5% of an average household's environmental impact. In contrast, transportation choices, dietary patterns (particularly meat consumption), and home energy use together comprise more than 70%. While recycling remains worthwhile, focusing public education on recycling may inadvertently divert attention from far more significant behavioral changes.
items.question: What is the author's main argument?

options.text: Since recycling accounts for under 5% of household impact, public recycling programs should be scaled back.
Stressing recycling in public education may divert attention from household choices with far larger impacts.
Cutting meat consumption is the single most effective environmental step that a household can take.
Most households overestimate the benefit of their recycling, which is why their overall footprints stay so high.

items.explanation_ko: 저자는 재활용이 여전히 가치 있다고 인정하면서도, 가계 환경 영향의 5% 미만에 불과한 재활용에 공공 교육이 집중되면 70% 이상을 차지하는 교통·식단·에너지 같은 더 중요한 행동 변화에서 관심을 빼앗을 수 있다고 주장한다. B가 이 주장을 정확히 담는다. 오답: A는 '재활용은 여전히 가치 있다'는 저자의 단서와 반대로 축소를 주장하고, C는 세 요인 중 식단을 1위로 순위 매긴 적이 없으며, D는 가정의 인식(과대평가)을 탄소 발자국이 큰 원인으로 제시하는데 지문은 그런 인과를 말하지 않는다.

items.stimulus: A health coach argues: 'Adults who exercise regularly report higher levels of life satisfaction than those who don't. Therefore, anyone seeking to improve their life satisfaction should start an exercise program.'
items.question: The coach's argument depends on which of the following assumptions?

options.text: Adults who do not exercise regularly are, for the most part, dissatisfied with their lives.
Regular exercise raises life satisfaction more than any other change a typical adult could reasonably make.
Most people who want greater life satisfaction already know that it is linked to exercise.
Exercise tends to raise life satisfaction, rather than satisfied people simply being likelier to exercise.

items.explanation_ko: 코치는 '운동하는 사람이 삶의 만족도가 높다'는 상관관계에서 '만족도를 높이려면 운동을 시작하라'는 인과적 처방을 끌어낸다. 이 처방이 성립하려면 운동이 만족도를 높이는 원인이어야 하고, 이미 만족한 사람이 운동을 더 하는 역인과가 아니어야 하므로 D가 필요한 가정이다. 오답: A는 비운동자 대부분이 불만족이라는 절대적 주장으로, 상대적 차이만 있으면 되므로 필요 없다. B는 운동이 '다른 어떤 변화보다' 효과적이라는 주장인데, 코치는 운동이 최선이라고 하지 않았다. C는 사람들이 그 관련성을 알고 있는지에 관한 것으로 논증의 타당성과 무관하다.

items.stimulus: Public health official Dr. Brown argues that smoking restrictions in public places reduce overall smoking rates. She bases her hypothesis on observations that several countries have reduced smoking after implementing such restrictions.
items.question: Which of the following, if true, would most strongly support Dr. Brown's hypothesis?

options.text: Countries adopting restrictions saw larger drops in smoking than similar countries without them, even allowing for tax changes.
In several of these countries, smoking rates had already begun falling steadily in the years before restrictions were introduced.
Surveys in these countries show that most non-smokers strongly supported the restrictions when they were introduced.
Smokers in countries with restrictions report that they now smoke more at home than they did before the rules.

items.explanation_ko: 박사의 가설은 공공장소 흡연 규제가 흡연율을 낮춘다는 인과 주장이고, 근거는 규제 후 흡연이 줄었다는 관찰뿐이다. A는 규제를 하지 않은 비슷한 나라들과 비교해도, 세금 변화를 감안해도 규제 국가의 감소폭이 더 컸다고 하므로 '원래 줄고 있었을 뿐'이라는 대안 설명을 차단해 가설을 가장 강하게 지지한다. 오답: B는 규제 전부터 흡연율이 떨어지고 있었다는 것이므로 오히려 가설을 약화한다. C는 비흡연자의 지지 여부로 흡연율 변화와 무관하고, D는 흡연 장소가 집으로 옮겨갔다는 것이어서 전체 흡연 감소를 지지하지 않는다.

items.stimulus: A tech company claims: 'Our new productivity app increases work efficiency. In our beta test, users completed an average of 30% more tasks per day after installing our app.'
items.question: Which of the following, if true, most weakens the company's claim?

options.text: Beta testers rated the app easy to learn, and most said they would recommend it to their colleagues.
A few testers completed fewer tasks after installing the app, though the group average still rose by 30%.
Competing productivity apps advertise similar gains, although few have published any beta-test results.
The testers were volunteers who began an intensive productivity training course when they installed the app.

items.explanation_ko: 회사는 앱 설치 후 처리 업무가 30% 늘었다는 결과로 앱이 효율을 높인다고 주장한다. D처럼 테스터들이 앱 설치와 동시에 집중적인 생산성 교육을 시작했다면, 증가분이 앱이 아니라 교육 때문일 수 있어 인과 주장이 가장 크게 약해진다. 오답: A는 사용 편의와 추천 의향으로 효과 자체와 무관하고, B는 일부 개인의 감소가 있어도 평균 30% 증가라는 근거는 그대로이며, C는 경쟁 앱의 광고 이야기로 이 앱의 효과 판단에 영향을 주지 않는다.

items.stimulus: Economic data on small businesses reveals an interesting pattern. Among businesses founded each year, about 20% fail in the first year and roughly half fail within five years. However, businesses that survive their first decade have a remarkably low failure rate—less than 5% per year. Researchers attribute this 'survivorship effect' to multiple factors: established customer bases, refined operational processes, accumulated capital reserves, and stronger industry relationships.
items.question: Which of the following can be most reliably inferred?

options.text: Most small businesses that survive their first year will go on to survive their first decade as well.
A business's age itself lowers its failure risk, independently of the resources and relationships it builds.
Founders could largely avoid early failure by securing large capital reserves before they open.
Businesses that have lasted a decade face a much lower yearly risk of failure than newly founded ones.

items.explanation_ko: 지문에 따르면 창업 첫해에 약 20%가 실패하지만, 10년을 버틴 기업은 연간 실패율이 5% 미만이다. D는 이 두 수치를 그대로 비교한 것이어서 가장 확실하게 추론된다. 오답: A는 첫해 생존 기업의 다수가 10년까지 간다는 주장인데, 5년 내 절반이 실패한다는 자료만으로는 10년 생존 비율을 알 수 없다. B는 연구자들이 고객 기반·자본·관계 같은 축적 요인을 원인으로 든 것과 반대로 '나이 자체'를 원인으로 보았고, C는 자본 확보만으로 초기 실패를 대부분 피할 수 있다는 지문에 없는 처방이다.

items.stimulus: Standard accounts of the Apollo lunar program celebrate the brilliance of NASA engineers and the courage of astronauts, and rightly so. But these accounts often overlook the foundational scientific work performed by computer pioneer Margaret Hamilton, mathematician Katherine Johnson, and the hundreds of women whose calculations and programming made the missions possible. Without their contributions—often performed under conditions of significant gender and racial discrimination—the Apollo program could not have succeeded. Recovering this history matters not only for historical accuracy but also for understanding how scientific achievements emerge from collective work, not just individual genius.
items.question: What is the author's main argument?

options.text: Apollo succeeded through many contributors, including overlooked women, showing that scientific achievement is collective.
Accounts crediting engineers and astronauts for Apollo's success are mistaken and should be replaced.
Discrimination against women at NASA was the main obstacle the Apollo program had to overcome.
Margaret Hamilton and Katherine Johnson contributed more to Apollo's success than the astronauts and senior engineers did.

items.explanation_ko: 저자는 엔지니어와 우주비행사에 대한 찬사가 정당하다고 인정하면서도, 간과된 여성들의 계산과 프로그래밍 없이는 아폴로가 성공할 수 없었고 이는 과학적 성취가 집단적 작업에서 나온다는 점을 보여 준다고 주장한다. A가 이 핵심을 담는다. 오답: B는 기존 서술을 '잘못되었으니 대체하라'고 했지만 저자는 '정당하다(rightly so)'고 했다. C는 차별을 프로그램의 주된 장애물로 보았는데 지문은 차별 속에서 일했다고만 한다. D는 개인 간 기여도 비교로, 오히려 개인 천재론을 비판하는 저자의 취지와 어긋난다.

items.stimulus: Studies of workplace motivation have found that employees who feel their work has clear purpose and impact tend to report higher job satisfaction than those who don't, even when controlling for salary differences. Research suggests that meaningful work activates psychological reward systems that simple compensation alone cannot replace.
items.question: Which of the following can be most reasonably inferred from the passage?

options.text: Once employees see their work as meaningful, raising their salaries has little further effect on satisfaction.
Employees whose work feels meaningful are more productive than others, regardless of how much they are paid.
People who choose meaningful careers usually accept lower pay in exchange for greater job satisfaction.
A sense of purpose and impact appears to raise job satisfaction in a way that pay alone does not account for.

items.explanation_ko: 지문은 급여 차이를 통제해도 일의 목적과 영향력을 느끼는 직원의 만족도가 더 높고, 의미 있는 일이 보상만으로는 대체할 수 없는 보상 체계를 작동시킨다고 말한다. 따라서 D처럼 의미감이 급여로 설명되지 않는 방식으로 만족도를 높인다는 추론이 가장 적절하다. 오답: A는 '대체할 수 없다'를 '급여 인상이 효과 없다'로 비약했고, B는 지문에 없는 생산성을 다뤘으며, C는 의미 있는 직업을 택한 사람들이 낮은 급여를 감수한다는, 지문에 근거가 없는 주장이다.

items.stimulus: Sociologist Dr. Reyes argues that volunteer work in early adulthood produces lasting positive effects on mental health. She bases this on a study showing that adults aged 30-40 who had volunteered in their 20s reported better mental health than peers who had not volunteered.
items.question: Which of the following, if true, would most strengthen Dr. Reyes's argument?

options.text: Adults who volunteered in their 20s were also more likely to be volunteering in their 30s.
Many volunteers in the study chose roles that involved helping people who used mental health services.
The volunteers still had better mental health a decade on after controlling for income, education and baseline health.
Young adults who already had good mental health were noticeably more likely than their peers to sign up for volunteer work.

items.explanation_ko: 박사의 근거는 20대에 봉사한 사람이 30대에 정신건강이 더 좋다는 비교뿐이어서, 원래 건강하거나 형편이 좋은 사람이 봉사를 했을 가능성이 남는다. C는 기저 정신건강·소득·교육을 통제한 뒤에도 차이가 10년 뒤까지 남았다고 하므로 이 대안 설명을 차단해 주장을 가장 강하게 지지한다. 오답: A는 30대에도 계속 봉사했다는 것이어서 효과가 '초기 봉사'의 지속 효과인지 현재 봉사 때문인지 오히려 흐린다. B는 봉사 분야에 관한 정보로 효과와 무관하고, D는 원래 건강한 사람이 봉사를 택했다는 역인과로 주장을 약화한다.

items.stimulus: An animal rights advocate argues: 'Animal testing is inhumane and unnecessary. Modern alternatives like computer modeling and cell cultures can replace all animal testing in medical research without compromising scientific validity.'
items.question: Which of the following, if true, most weakens the advocate's argument?

options.text: Alternatives still cannot reliably predict how a drug affects several organ systems over time in a whole organism.
Computer models and cell cultures are generally cheaper and faster to run than comparable animal studies.
Many laboratories still use animals mainly because regulators have not yet updated the rules for approving new drugs.
Public opinion surveys show that most people oppose animal testing for cosmetics and household products.

items.explanation_ko: 옹호자의 핵심 주장은 대체 기법이 과학적 타당성을 잃지 않고 '모든' 동물실험을 대체할 수 있다는 것이다. A는 여러 장기에 걸친 약물 작용과 장기적 효과처럼 살아 있는 개체가 여전히 필요한 영역이 있다고 하므로 '모두 대체 가능'을 직접 반박한다. 오답: B는 대체 기법이 더 싸고 빠르다는 것으로 오히려 옹호자 편이고, C는 동물실험이 규제 관성 때문에 남아 있다는 것이어서 '불필요하다'는 주장을 지지한다. D는 화장품 실험에 대한 여론으로 의학 연구의 대체 가능성과 무관하다.

items.stimulus: In recent surveys of customers who had used both AI chatbots and human representatives—almost always with the option of switching to a human agent—customers rated 70% of their AI interactions as fully resolved. A workforce researcher concludes: 'AI-powered chatbots can replace customer service representatives in 70% of interactions. Companies should aggressively automate their customer service to reduce costs by 50% or more while maintaining service quality.'
items.question: The researcher's argument depends on which of the following assumptions?

options.text: The survey results will still hold once customers can no longer turn to a human agent when the AI falls short.
Most customers prefer dealing with AI chatbots over human representatives when their query is routine.
AI chatbots will keep improving until they can handle well over 70% of customer service interactions.
Companies that have already automated most of their customer service report higher profits than those that have not.

items.explanation_ko: 연구자는 AI와 사람 상담을 모두 경험한 고객 설문에서 70%를 AI가 대체할 수 있다고 나왔으니 상담을 공격적으로 자동화해도 품질이 유지된다고 결론짓는다. 그런데 설문 응답자는 AI가 막히면 사람에게 넘어갈 수 있는 상황에서 답했으므로, 사람 연결 없이 AI만 남겨도 같은 결과가 나온다는 A가 성립해야 결론이 유지된다. 오답: B(AI 선호)는 대체 가능성만 있으면 되므로 필요 없고, C(70% 이상으로의 향상)는 70%만으로 주장이 성립하므로 필요 없으며, D(타사 수익)는 결론을 뒷받침할 수는 있어도 논증이 전제로 삼는 내용이 아니다.

items.stimulus: An education official reports: 'Recent test data show that students who use online learning platforms regularly score 8% higher on standardised assessments than students who don't. We should therefore mandate online platform use across all schools to improve student outcomes.'
items.question: Which of the following, if true, would most seriously weaken the official's conclusion?

options.text: Some students find online platforms distracting and would rather study from printed textbooks.
Platforms vary in quality, and the best of them produce larger score gains than the 8% average.
Schools would need substantial new funding for devices and teacher training to meet such a mandate.
Regular users tended to come from better-resourced homes; among similar homes the score gap was under 1%.

items.explanation_ko: 공무원은 온라인 플랫폼 이용 학생의 점수가 8% 높다는 상관에서 의무화하면 성적이 오른다는 인과 결론을 낸다. D는 이용 학생들이 원래 가정 여건이 좋았고, 비슷한 가정끼리 비교하면 차이가 1% 미만으로 줄었다고 하므로 효과의 대부분이 플랫폼이 아니라 가정 배경 때문임을 보여 결론을 가장 크게 약화한다. 오답: A는 일부 학생의 선호로 평균 효과를 반박하지 못하고, B는 플랫폼 간 품질 차이로 오히려 효과가 있다는 전제 위에 있으며, C는 시행 비용 문제로 '성적이 오른다'는 인과 주장 자체에는 영향이 없다.

items.stimulus: The Scientific Revolution is often dated from Copernicus's heliocentric model in 1543 to Newton's Principia in 1687. This conventional periodisation, while convenient, can obscure how much of what we call 'modern science' developed gradually over the following centuries. Blinded experimentation did not emerge until the late 1700s, and the double-blind trial did not become standard practice until the 20th century. Many of the statistical methods used to analyse data were developed in the 19th and early 20th centuries. Peer review as we now understand it became standard practice only in the mid-20th century. The infrastructure of modern science—funded laboratories, professional researchers, university research departments, scientific journals with editorial boards—is overwhelmingly an institutional achievement of the 19th and 20th centuries built on conceptual foundations laid earlier. Understanding science as a 16th-century achievement underestimates how recent its current institutional form actually is.
items.question: What is the author's central argument?

options.text: The 'Scientific Revolution' is a misleading label, since modern science really began only in the 19th century.
Because many of its key methods are recent, modern science rests on weaker foundations than usually assumed.
Dating science to 1543-1687 overstates the contributions of Copernicus and Newton relative to later scientists.
Science's conceptual roots are early, but much of its institutional form arose in the 19th and 20th centuries.

items.explanation_ko: 저자는 과학혁명의 개념적 기초가 16~17세기에 놓였음은 인정하면서도, 맹검 실험·통계 기법·동료 평가·연구실과 학술지 같은 현대 과학의 제도적 형태는 대부분 19~20세기에 만들어졌다고 주장한다. D가 이 '개념은 이르게, 제도는 늦게'라는 구조를 정확히 담는다. 오답: A는 현대 과학이 19세기에야 시작됐다고 해 저자가 인정한 초기 개념적 기초를 부정하고, B는 '최근에 발달했다'를 '기초가 약하다'로 비약했으며, C는 코페르니쿠스·뉴턴과 후대 과학자의 기여를 비교하는데 지문은 그런 비교를 하지 않았다.

items.stimulus: Dr. Kim hypothesises that her hospital's higher patient survival rates compared to neighbouring hospitals reflect the quality of care her hospital provides. Critics suggest the difference may simply reflect that her hospital admits less severely ill patients, who would have better outcomes regardless of treatment quality.
items.question: Which of the following, if true, would most strongly support Dr. Kim's hypothesis?

options.text: Dr. Kim's hospital treats more patients each year than any of the neighbouring hospitals.
Neighbouring hospitals receive a larger share of ambulance transfers involving patients who are in critical condition.
Dr. Kim's hospital spends more per patient on staff training than the neighbouring hospitals do.
Within each admission-severity group, Dr. Kim's hospital still has higher survival rates than its neighbours.

items.explanation_ko: 비판자들은 생존율 차이가 진료 질이 아니라 덜 위중한 환자를 받기 때문일 수 있다고 반박한다. D는 입원 시 중증도별로 나누어 같은 중증도끼리 비교해도 김 박사 병원의 생존율이 높다고 하므로 환자 구성 차이라는 대안 설명을 직접 제거해 가설을 가장 강하게 지지한다. 오답: A는 환자 수로 질과 무관하고, B는 인근 병원이 위중 환자를 더 받는다는 것이어서 비판자 쪽 설명을 지지한다. C는 교육 투자라는 투입 지표일 뿐 그것이 생존율 차이를 만든다는 근거가 없고 환자 구성 문제에도 답하지 못한다.

items.stimulus: Confirmation bias—the tendency to favour information confirming existing beliefs and discount information challenging them—operates across virtually all human cognitive activities. Importantly, this bias does not primarily reflect intellectual laziness or dishonest reasoning. Skilled experts demonstrate it as much as novices, often more so because their existing knowledge generates richer interpretive frameworks. Even researchers explicitly designing studies to test their own hypotheses show subtle confirmation effects in how they collect data, interpret ambiguous results, and select examples for publication. The bias is not eliminated by good intentions; it requires active structural countermeasures—pre-registration of hypotheses, blind data analysis, adversarial collaboration—that constrain how easily one's existing beliefs can shape what counts as evidence.
items.question: Which of the following can be most reasonably inferred from the passage?

options.text: Experts display stronger confirmation bias than novices in every field in which the bias has been studied.
A sincere effort to be objective is unlikely on its own to prevent confirmation bias, even among experts.
Confirmation bias arises mainly when researchers are careless or are motivated to mislead their readers.
Adopting pre-registration and blind analysis will remove confirmation bias from published research.

items.explanation_ko: 지문은 확증 편향이 게으름이나 부정직 때문이 아니며, 전문가에게도 같거나 더 강하게 나타나고, 좋은 의도로는 제거되지 않아 구조적 장치가 필요하다고 말한다. B처럼 객관적이려는 진심 어린 노력만으로는 전문가에게서도 편향을 막기 어렵다는 추론이 가장 적절하다. 오답: A는 '흔히 더 강하다(often more so)'를 '모든 분야에서 더 강하다'로 확대했고, C는 '게으름이나 부정직 때문이 아니다'라는 지문과 정면으로 어긋나며, D는 대응책이 편향을 '제거한다'고 단정했는데 지문은 영향을 제약한다고만 했다.

items.stimulus: An energy policy critic argues: 'Solar panels are not as environmentally beneficial as commonly believed. Manufacturing solar panels requires substantial energy and produces significant pollution. The recent surge in solar adoption has therefore likely worsened, not improved, environmental outcomes overall.'
items.question: Which of the following, if true, would most seriously weaken the critic's conclusion?

options.text: Manufacturing solar panels does release toxic by-products that require careful handling and disposal.
Solar panel efficiency has improved, so newer panels generate more power per square metre than older ones.
Over their lifetime, solar panels emit far less in total than the fossil fuel electricity they replace.
Several prominent critics of solar power have received research funding from fossil fuel companies.

items.explanation_ko: 비평가는 패널 제조의 에너지 소비와 오염을 근거로 태양광 확산이 전체 환경 결과를 오히려 악화시켰다고 결론짓는다. C는 제조를 포함한 전 생애 배출량이 대체되는 화석연료 발전보다 훨씬 적다고 하므로, 제조 비용을 감안해도 순효과가 긍정적임을 보여 결론을 가장 크게 약화한다. 오답: A는 제조 과정의 유해 부산물을 인정하는 내용이라 비평가 쪽에 가깝고, B는 효율 향상만 말할 뿐 제조 부담을 상쇄하는지 알려 주지 않으며, D는 비판자의 이해관계를 공격하는 것으로 주장 내용 자체를 반박하지 못한다.

items.stimulus: An education official argues: 'Schools that have adopted iPad-based learning consistently show test scores 12% higher than schools using traditional textbook methods. Therefore, all schools in our state should transition to iPad-based learning to improve student performance across the system.'
items.question: The official's argument depends on which of the following assumptions?

options.text: iPads are more effective learning tools than other brands of tablet computer used in schools.
Teachers in the iPad-adopting schools received training in how to use the devices in class.
Equipping every school with iPads would cost the state less than replacing all its textbooks.
The higher scores come from the iPads rather than from other advantages those schools already had.

items.explanation_ko: 관료는 아이패드 도입 학교의 점수가 12% 높다는 비교에서 모든 학교가 전환하면 성적이 오른다고 결론짓는다. 이 결론이 성립하려면 점수 차이가 아이패드 때문이고, 도입 학교가 원래 가진 재정·교사·학급 규모 같은 다른 이점 때문이 아니어야 하므로 D가 필요한 가정이다. 오답: A(다른 브랜드 태블릿과의 비교)는 아이패드 대 교과서 비교 논증에 필요 없고, B(교사 연수)는 효과의 경로일 수는 있어도 논증이 반드시 전제하는 것은 아니며, C(비용)는 성적 향상이라는 결론과 무관하다.

items.stimulus: Public discussions of crime often present an apparent dilemma between 'tough on crime' approaches (longer sentences, more incarceration) and 'soft on crime' approaches (rehabilitation, community alternatives). This framing is misleading. The empirical evidence strongly favours neither extreme as universally optimal. Long sentences modestly deter some crimes but produce diminishing returns and social costs that begin to outweigh benefits beyond moderate levels. Rehabilitation programs reduce recidivism for some offender populations and offence types, but their effectiveness varies substantially by program design and offender characteristics. The actual question for policy is not whether to be 'tough' or 'soft' but rather what combination of approaches—calibrated to specific crime types, offender risk levels, and community contexts—produces the best aggregate outcomes given finite resources. Treating it as a simple ideological choice between two camps obscures the empirical complexity that effective policy must engage.
items.question: What is the author's central argument?

options.text: Long prison sentences fail to deter crime and should be replaced with rehabilitation programs.
Crime policy should combine approaches suited to specific crimes and offenders, not pick 'tough' or 'soft'.
Rehabilitation is the better approach overall, provided that programs are carefully designed for the right offenders.
Politicians adopt 'tough' or 'soft' positions mainly to win votes rather than on the basis of evidence.

items.explanation_ko: 저자는 '강경 대 온건'이라는 이분법이 오해를 낳는다며, 증거는 어느 극단도 보편적 최선으로 지지하지 않으므로 범죄 유형·위험도·지역 맥락에 맞춰 여러 방식을 조합해야 한다고 주장한다. B가 이를 정확히 요약한다. 오답: A는 장기형이 '일부 범죄를 어느 정도 억제한다'는 지문과 어긋나는 극단이고, C는 재활 쪽을 전반적으로 더 낫다고 편들어 저자가 거부한 양자택일로 되돌아가며, D는 정치인의 동기를 다루는데 지문은 그런 주장을 하지 않는다.

items.stimulus: City planning data show that residents living within 500 metres of public parks report life satisfaction scores 14% above the city average. Some city councillors have cited this as evidence that expanding park access would improve residents' wellbeing. However, additional analysis reveals that homes near parks command 22% higher real estate prices on average, meaning that park-adjacent residents tend to have substantially higher incomes than the typical resident. When researchers controlled for household income, the satisfaction differential dropped to 4%, and when they additionally controlled for the resident's specific neighbourhood (which captures schools, services, and other amenities), the gap shrank further to under 1%.
items.question: Which of the following can be most reasonably inferred from the passage?

options.text: Living near a park has no effect on wellbeing, so park expansion should not be a priority for the city.
Most of the original satisfaction gap reflects income and neighbourhood differences rather than the parks.
Higher household income is the main cause of higher life satisfaction for residents across the city.
Building a new park in a neighbourhood raises nearby home prices by about 22% on average.

items.explanation_ko: 공원 근처 주민의 만족도 우위 14%는 소득을 통제하면 4%, 동네 특성까지 통제하면 1% 미만으로 줄어든다. 따라서 B처럼 원래 차이의 대부분이 공원 자체가 아니라 소득과 동네 특성을 반영한다고 추론할 수 있다. 오답: A는 1% 미만을 '효과 없음'으로 단정하고 정책 결론까지 내렸으며, C는 공원 인근 주민 자료를 도시 전체 만족도의 주원인 판단으로 확대했고, D는 공원 인근 집값이 22% 높다는 상관을 '공원을 지으면 집값이 오른다'는 인과로 바꿨다.

items.stimulus: Economist Dr. Lee argues that moderate increases in the minimum wage (10-15%) do not significantly reduce employment, contrary to traditional economic theory predictions. Critics respond that her conclusion contradicts well-established economic principles and that any apparent absence of employment effect must reflect measurement errors or unique circumstances of the studies cited.
items.question: Which of the following, if true, would most strongly support Dr. Lee's argument?

options.text: Many studies using different methods in many countries find moderate rises leave jobs within 1% of baseline.
Several economists argue that traditional labour market models rest on unrealistic assumptions.
After one moderate increase, employment in the affected city rose, though a large factory happened to open there that year.
Most workers earning the minimum wage are adults rather than teenagers in their first jobs.

items.explanation_ko: 비판자들은 리 박사의 결과가 측정 오류나 특수한 사례 때문이라고 반박한다. A는 여러 나라에서 다양한 방법을 쓴 다수 연구가 일관되게 고용 변화가 1% 안팎이라고 확인했다고 하므로, 특정 방법이나 사례의 우연이라는 반박을 동시에 무력화해 주장을 가장 강하게 지지한다. 오답: B는 이론 비판 의견일 뿐 실증 근거가 아니고, C는 공장 신설이라는 다른 요인이 겹친 단일 사례라 바로 비판자가 말한 '특수 상황'에 해당하며, D는 최저임금 노동자의 연령 구성으로 고용 효과와 무관하다.

items.stimulus: A health columnist writes: 'A new study followed 5,000 adults over ten years and found that those who consumed two or more servings of vegetables daily had 20% lower rates of chronic disease than those consuming less than one serving daily. This proves that vegetable consumption directly causes better long-term health, and public health campaigns should aggressively promote vegetable intake.'
items.question: Which of the following, if true, would most seriously weaken the columnist's conclusion?

options.text: The high-vegetable group also exercised more and smoked less, and this was not adjusted for in the study.
An earlier, shorter study found a 12% difference in chronic disease between the same two intake groups.
Some types of vegetable provide considerably more nutrients and health benefits than others.
The study was published in a respected medical journal after a rigorous peer review process.

items.explanation_ko: 칼럼니스트는 채소 섭취와 만성질환 감소의 상관을 근거로 채소가 '직접 원인'이라고 단정한다. A는 채소를 많이 먹는 집단이 운동도 더 하고 흡연도 덜 했는데 이를 보정하지 않았다고 하므로, 차이가 다른 생활습관 때문일 수 있어 인과 결론을 가장 크게 약화한다. 오답: B는 다른 연구에서도 같은 방향의 차이(12%)가 나왔다는 것이라 오히려 연관성을 지지하고, C는 채소 종류별 영양 차이로 인과 여부와 무관하며, D는 학술지 게재 사실로 연구 설계의 교란 문제를 해결하지 못한다.

items.stimulus: Public discussions of memory often assume that vivid, emotionally charged memories are also accurate ones—that the strong feeling of 'I remember it like it was yesterday' indicates reliable factual recall. Cognitive research has revealed a more complicated picture. Vivid emotional memories, including those for major personal or public events, are reconstructed each time they are recalled, and details can change in ways the rememberer is not aware of. The Challenger explosion, the September 11 attacks, and other 'flashbulb' events have been studied: people's memories of where they were, what they were doing, and even what they felt have been shown to drift substantially over years, while their confidence in those memories remains high or even increases. The implications for legal testimony, historical narrative, and personal relationship disputes are substantial—but the more general point is that the felt vividness of a memory is a poor guide to its accuracy.
items.question: Which of the following can be most reasonably inferred from the passage?

options.text: Emotional memories are generally less accurate than memories of ordinary, everyday events.
People whose memories of an event drift over time usually become less confident in those memories.
Feeling vivid certainty about a memory is not good evidence that the memory is actually accurate.
Witness testimony about emotionally charged events should be excluded from legal proceedings.

items.explanation_ko: 지문은 생생한 감정 기억도 회상할 때마다 재구성되어 세부가 달라지지만, 당사자의 확신은 그대로이거나 오히려 커진다고 하며 '생생함은 정확성의 좋은 지표가 아니다'라고 정리한다. C가 이를 그대로 담는다. 오답: A는 감정 기억이 일상 기억보다 덜 정확하다는 비교인데 지문은 그런 비교를 하지 않았고, B는 기억이 변하면 확신이 줄어든다는 것으로 '확신이 유지되거나 커진다'는 지문과 반대이며, D는 법정 증언을 배제하라는 처방으로 지문의 '시사점이 크다'를 넘어선다.

items.stimulus: Cities are often portrayed as fundamentally bad for the environment—as concrete jungles that destroy nature and consume resources. This portrayal contains real concerns but obscures a more interesting reality. Densely populated cities, when measured per capita rather than in total, typically have lower carbon footprints than equivalent populations spread across suburbs and rural areas. Urban residents drive less, use public transit more, share infrastructure across many users, and live in smaller dwellings that consume less heating and cooling energy. The challenge for environmental policy is therefore not simply 'preserving nature from cities' but designing cities that capture these efficiency advantages while addressing the genuine harms of dense living—air pollution concentration, urban heat islands, stormwater management, biodiversity loss in immediate surroundings. Done well, urbanisation can be a positive environmental force; done poorly, it intensifies harms that lower-density living might have spread thinly enough to absorb.
items.question: What is the author's central argument?

options.text: Dense cities are better for the environment than suburbs and should be expanded wherever possible.
Cities can be better for the environment per person, but only if designed to address the harms of density.
What matters most about a city's environmental impact is its total resource use, not its per-capita footprint.
Lower-density living spreads environmental harms thinly enough that it is the safer choice overall.

items.explanation_ko: 저자는 밀집 도시가 1인당 기준으로는 탄소 발자국이 더 낮을 수 있지만, 오염 집중·열섬·빗물·생물다양성 같은 밀집의 해로움을 설계로 다루어야만 그 이점이 실현된다고 주장한다. B가 이 조건부 결론을 담는다. 오답: A는 '어디서나 확장하라'는 조건 없는 일반화이고, C는 총량이 1인당보다 중요하다는 것으로 저자가 1인당 기준을 강조한 것과 반대이며, D는 저밀도 생활이 더 안전하다는 결론으로 저자의 논지와 어긋난다.

items.stimulus: An ethicist argues: 'Facial recognition technology should be banned in public spaces. Even when used for legitimate security purposes, the technology creates a chilling effect on free assembly: people become reluctant to attend protests or political gatherings because they fear being identified and tracked. Recent attendance at political rallies in cities that have deployed facial recognition has declined by 25% compared to similar cities without the technology.'
items.question: The ethicist's argument depends on which of the following assumptions?

options.text: Facial recognition systems are now accurate enough to identify most individuals in a large crowd.
People who stop attending rallies will find other ways to express their political views instead.
Facial recognition in these cities is used far more often for crime prevention than for tracking protesters or organisers.
The lower rally turnout in those cities is due to the technology rather than other differences between them.

items.explanation_ko: 윤리학자는 얼굴 인식 도입 도시의 집회 참석이 비슷한 도시보다 25% 줄었다는 비교를 위축 효과의 증거로 쓴다. 이 근거가 유효하려면 감소가 기술 때문이고 정치 분위기나 쟁점 차이 같은 다른 요인 때문이 아니어야 하므로 D가 필요한 가정이다. 오답: A는 실제 식별 정확도에 관한 것인데, 위축 효과는 사람들의 두려움만으로 생기므로 필요 없다. B는 사람들이 다른 방식으로 의견을 표현할지에 관한 것으로 결론과 무관하고, C는 기술의 주된 용도에 관한 것이라 위축 효과가 생기는지와는 관계가 없다.

items.stimulus: Online surveys conducted by news organisations and political campaigns frequently produce results that conflict with subsequent election outcomes. The pattern is consistent enough to warrant attention. Online surveys typically reach respondents who chose to participate—a self-selection that differs systematically from the general population. People sufficiently engaged with politics to respond to online surveys tend to hold stronger and more polarised views than the median voter. They are also more likely to over-report intended turnout, with surveys generally predicting voter participation 10-15 percentage points higher than what actually occurs. Random-digit dial telephone surveys produce more representative samples but face their own challenges from declining response rates. No survey method now in use produces unproblematic predictions, and combinations of methods tend to outperform any single method.
items.question: Which of the following can be most reasonably inferred from the passage?

options.text: Telephone surveys now produce more accurate election forecasts than any online survey can.
Online surveys overstate turnout mainly because they reach a disproportionate number of young voters.
A forecast based on a single online survey warrants caution, given its self-selected respondents.
Survey-based forecasting has become too unreliable to be of any use in predicting elections.

items.explanation_ko: 지문은 온라인 설문이 자기선택 표본과 투표 의향 과대 응답 때문에 결과가 어긋나기 쉽고, 어떤 방법도 완벽하지 않으며 방법을 조합하면 더 낫다고 말한다. 따라서 C처럼 온라인 설문 하나에 근거한 예측은 신중히 다뤄야 한다는 추론이 가장 적절하다. 오답: A는 전화 설문이 표본은 더 대표적이지만 응답률 문제가 있다고만 한 지문을 넘어 정확도 우위를 단정했고, B는 과대 응답의 원인을 젊은 층으로 지목했는데 지문은 정치 관여도가 높은 응답자를 원인으로 든다. D는 '예측이 쓸모없다'는 극단으로 조합 방식이 더 낫다는 지문과 어긋난다.

items.stimulus: Economist Dr. Schmidt proposes that universal basic income (UBI)—monthly payments to all adults regardless of work status—would reduce poverty without significantly reducing employment. Critics argue this is implausible: if people receive guaranteed income, many will reduce their work effort, undermining both productivity and the economic activity needed to fund the program.
items.question: Which of the following, if true, would most strongly support Dr. Schmidt's argument?

options.text: Several prominent economists have endorsed basic income in academic papers and public lectures.
Recipients in one pilot program spent most of their payments on food, rent, transport and other everyday essentials.
Controlled trials in two countries found recipients cut their working hours by only 1-2% versus non-recipients.
A basic income would be simpler for governments to administer than existing welfare programs.

items.explanation_ko: 비판자들은 기본소득을 받으면 근로 의욕이 줄어 생산성과 재원이 무너진다고 반박한다. C는 두 나라의 통제 실험에서 수급자의 근로시간 감소가 비수급자 대비 1~2%에 그쳤다고 하므로 핵심 반박인 근로 감소를 실제 자료로 직접 부정해 주장을 가장 강하게 지지한다. 오답: A는 학자들의 지지 의견일 뿐 효과 증거가 아니고, B는 지급액의 사용처로 근로 의욕과 무관하며, D는 행정 간소화라는 별개의 장점으로 고용 문제에 답하지 못한다.

items.stimulus: Histories of medicine are often written as accounts of victories—diseases conquered, treatments discovered, mortality rates declining. This narrative captures real and important truths. However, focusing exclusively on victories obscures equally important features of medical history: treatments now recognised as harmful that were standard practice for decades (bloodletting, lobotomies, thalidomide for pregnancy nausea), populations actively harmed by medical research conducted without their consent, and successful treatments delayed for years because they conflicted with prevailing assumptions. A more accurate history of medicine would recognise both genuine progress and the systematic ways that confidence in current practice has repeatedly proven misplaced—not because contemporary doctors were unusually dishonest or incompetent, but because medicine, like any complex enterprise, makes mistakes that only become visible later. This historical pattern has implications for current practice: confidence that today's standard care is correct should be tempered by awareness that previous generations had the same confidence about practices we now recognise as flawed.
items.question: What is the author's central argument?

options.text: Medical history should record confident errors alongside real progress, tempering certainty about current care.
Medical history is better understood as a series of failures than as a story of genuine progress.
Because past doctors were so often confidently wrong, today's standard treatments should not be trusted by patients.
Past medical errors resulted mainly from practitioners who were careless or dishonest.

items.explanation_ko: 저자는 의학사가 실제 진보를 인정하되, 한때 확신을 가졌다가 나중에야 잘못이 드러난 관행들도 함께 기록해야 하며, 이 인식이 현재 표준 진료에 대한 확신을 누그러뜨려야 한다고 주장한다. A가 이를 담는다. 오답: B는 진보 서사를 실패 서사로 바꾸자는 것으로 '진보는 실제'라는 저자의 인정과 어긋나고, C는 확신을 '누그러뜨려야' 한다는 저자의 말을 '믿지 말라'로 비약했으며, D는 과거 의사들이 부주의하거나 부정직했다는 것으로 저자가 명시적으로 부정한 내용이다.

items.stimulus: A psychologist argues: 'Social media use during meals reduces family communication. Surveys show families that allow phones at the dinner table report 35% lower rates of 'meaningful conversation' compared to families with phone-free meal policies. Therefore, banning phones at family meals would substantially improve family relationships.'
items.question: Which of the following, if true, would most seriously weaken the psychologist's conclusion?

options.text: Many family members say they enjoy checking their phones during meals and do not want a ban.
Phone-free families already had stronger relationship habits; among similar families the gap fell below 5%.
Most families surveyed said a phone ban at meals would be difficult to enforce with teenagers.
Some studies find that sharing content on a phone can occasionally prompt conversation at the table.

items.explanation_ko: 심리학자는 식탁 휴대전화 허용 가정의 '의미 있는 대화'가 35% 적다는 비교에서 금지하면 관계가 좋아진다고 결론짓는다. B는 휴대전화 금지 가정이 원래 관계 습관이 좋았고, 비슷한 가정끼리 비교하면 차이가 5% 미만으로 줄었다고 하므로 차이의 대부분이 기존 가족 특성 때문임을 보여 결론을 가장 크게 약화한다. 오답: A와 C는 가족들이 금지를 원하지 않거나 시행이 어렵다는 실행상의 문제일 뿐 효과 주장을 건드리지 않는다. D는 휴대전화가 가끔 대화를 유발할 수 있다는 정도로, 35% 차이라는 근거를 설명하지 못해 약화 정도가 미미하다.
